title: GeoReasoner: Reasoning On Geospatially Grounded Context For Natural Language Understanding

live_model.evidence: Sec.2.2: "a LLM (specifically GPT-4 Turbo in this study) is employed as a summarizer, utilizing its comprehensive capability to extract key information" to build pretraining data.

claim.metric: none (GPT-4 Turbo only generates location-description training text for GeoReasoner; no capability number reported for it)

data.source: OSM/Wikipedia/Wikidata (public sources), but the GPT-4-generated location descriptions are internal training data

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is a data-generation component (role A) feeding GeoReasoner's own contrastive-pretraining pipeline (CIKM'24); reported downstream benchmark numbers are GeoReasoner's, not GPT-4 Turbo's, and the summarisation prompt is not printed.
